internationalization.implementation: React State based dictionary hook (useTranslation or simple json translation object in src/constants/translations.js) allowing seamless instant toggle between Spanish and English.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a stunning, modern, high-conversion landing page and booking application for Slayed by Joana17 in Bilbao.
Follow the Afro Urban Luxury aesthetic with warm obsidian dark background (#0e0d0c), glowing gold (#E5A93C) and copper (#C86D4B) accents.
Implement language selection (ES/EN) toggle at the top navigation with instant translation of all headings, CTAs, tab labels, FAQs, and booking form steps.

Ensure the booking form is fully interactive with realistic date selection, service selection, client info inputs, backend API submission (or local storage fallback + server endpoint), and a simulated mobile push notification toast pop-up that notifies the client '📲 ¡Notificación enviada al móvil de Joana17!'

Include all requested sections: Hero, Social Proof, Por qué elegir Joana, Service & Price Catalog (with Mujer/Hombre/Extras tabs), Work Gallery, Testimonios, Sobre Joana, FAQ accordion, and Footer with Bilbao Map & Operating Hours.
Ensure every interactive element has a unique 'data-testid' attribute as specified in the schema.
Use Lucide icons (Calendar, Scissors, Sparkles, Clock, MapPin, Phone, Instagram, Star, CheckCircle, ShieldCheck, Heart, Globe, Bell) for visual polish.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Ensure text visibility against dark backgrounds with minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.responsive: Mobile first responsive design with grid collapse and touch-friendly targets.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Generous spacing (p-6, p-8, py-16, py-24) to ensure breathable, premium feel.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.components: Use Shadcn primitives (Tabs, Accordion, Dialog, Calendar, Select, Input, Toaster/Sonner) customized to match the Afro Urban theme.
